summary: Lewis and Clark NF lookout site in Meagher County; the only dated record is a July 1, 1938 notice naming a fireman lookout. No build date, status or site description found.

events.note: A July 1, 1938 newspaper notice names Bill Musgrave as the fireman lookout on Black Butte; the wording is future tense, so it reports a planned assignment

evidence.supports: Black Butte is listed under Meagher County
Black Butte is on the Lewis and Clark National Forest

evidence.quote: Bill Musgrave will be fireman lookout on Black Butte.

notes_for_editor: Record fields (Meagher County, Lewis and Clark NF, status unknown) match the Forest Lookouts pages; no correction proposed. Do not confuse this with us-mt-black-butte, the Lincoln County tower near Eureka on the Kootenai NF, whose story cites a different Forest Lookouts page (black-butte1.html). The only dated item for this site is the 1938 notice, so there are no build, status or staffing-end entries. Neither the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Montana list nor firelookout.com shows a Meagher County Black Butte. Access is unknown; no source describes the site now.
